glosses: arrival (act of arriving or something that has arrived)

examples.text: В августе 1762 года в городе Глупове происходило необычное движение по случаю прибытия нового градоначальника, Дементия Варламовича Брудастого.
examples.translation: In August 1762 there was an unaccustomed flurry of activity in Glupov, on the occasion of the arrival of the new town-governor, Dementy Varlamovich Brudasty.
examples.english: In August 1762 there was an unaccustomed flurry of activity in Glupov, on the occasion of the arrival of the new town-governor, Dementy Varlamovich Brudasty.

glosses: The act of arriving (reaching a certain place).

examples.text: The early arrival of the bride created a stir.

glosses: The fact of reaching a particular point in time.

examples.text: He celebrated the arrival of payday with a shopping spree.

glosses: The fact of beginning to occur; the initial phase of something.

examples.text: The arrival of puberty can be especially challenging for transgender youth.

glosses: The attainment of an objective, especially as a result of effort.

examples.text: The arrival of the railway made the local tourist industry viable.
